column3: Close to the Hebrew.
“A room in a room” is rendered “an inner room.”
“I anoint” is rendered “I have anointed.”
The repeated “the young man, the young man” is rendered “the young man, the servant of.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“I anoint” is rendered “I have anointed.”
NASB supplies “that.”
“One who urinates on a wall” is rendered “every male person,” and “shut up and freed” as “both bond and free.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew.
“Peace?” is rendered “Is all well?”, and “mad man” as “mad fellow.”
“Falsehood” is rendered “It is a lie.”
“The bone of the steps” is rendered “the bare steps”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Watching” is rendered “defending.”
“If it is your mind” is rendered “If this is your mind,” and NASB adds “or leave.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Crowd” is rendered “company.”
“Go around to after me” is rendered “Turn behind me.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“With madness” is rendered “furiously.”
“Harness” is rendered “Get ready,” and “portion of land” as “property.”
“Until” is rendered “so long as,” and NASB adds “so many.”
“Turned around his hands” is rendered “reined about,” and “treachery” as “There is treachery.”
“Filled his hand with the bow” is rendered “drew his bow with his full strength.”
“Riding pairs” is rendered “riding together,” and “lifted up … the oracle” as “laid this oracle.”
The oath form “if not” is rendered “Surely,” and “utterance of the LORD” as “says the LORD.”
The Hebrew בֵּית הַגָּן is rendered “the garden house,” and NASB supplies “So they shot him.”
“Made him ride” is rendered “carried him in a chariot.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Set her eyes with eye-paint” is rendered “painted her eyes,” and “looked down” as “looked out.”
